name: Ample Semiconductors Private Limited
india_angle: Ample Semiconductors is based in Bengaluru, India, and expanded operations to Hyderabad in 2025 to enhance market presence and capacity.
summary: Ample Semiconductors Private Limited specializes in providing design services within the semiconductor ecosystem, focusing on VLSI design, embedded systems, and AI/ML solutions. The company supports clients in developing custom silicon solutions and advancing applications in automotive, industrial, and IoT sectors.
